theorems.statement: ∀ (F Ω : Type) [NormedField F] [CompleteSpace F] [NormedField Ω] [NormedAlgebra F Ω] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F Ω], (∀ x y : Ω, ‖x + y‖ ≤ max ‖x‖ ‖y‖) → ∀ q : F, 0 < ‖q‖ → ‖q‖ < 1 → let qΩ : Ω := algebraMap F Ω q; ∀ u : Ωˣ, (¬ ∃ m : ℤ, (u : Ω) = qΩ ^ m) → Summable (fun n : ℤ => qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω) / (1 - qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω)) ^ 2) ∧ Summable (fun n : ℤ => (qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω)) ^ 2 / (1 - qΩ ^ n * (u : Ω)) ^ 3)
